picks.editorial_note: A £5M UK government-backed trial is putting AI-driven flight path adjustments into real skies to cut aviation's contrail-driven climate impact — a rare case of AI research moving directly into government climate policy and infrastructure testing.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: DOE selected a Fermilab-led team for its Genesis Mission to build AI systems controlling particle accelerator performance, a flagship national investment applying AI to frontier physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs from massive datasets often can't be traced to any training example — has major implications for AI copyright, authorship, and accountability debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on over $42 million in NSF grants building national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, a significant federal investment in the research computing backbone AI science depends on.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are combining AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate battery materials discovery, a concrete industry-academia push on a technology critical to the energy transition.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9M NSF-funded iDLab will unify browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advancing the NAIRR/AI research-infrastructure agenda for the broader academic community.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award to mine 50 years of water-quality data for critical minerals shows AI being applied to national supply-chain and resource security priorities.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Smith+Nephew launched a five-year center translating AI and computer-vision research into surgical robotics, a substantial academia-industry bet on real-world medical technology.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: A University of Houston report projecting up to 32% growth in U.S. electricity demand by 2030, driven partly by AI and data centers, offers hard data policymakers need for infrastructure planning amid the AI energy crunch.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: Old Dominion's NASA-funded AI 'digital twin' proved its value during real flooding in Norfolk, a rare instance of AI climate-resilience research being validated under live, high-stakes conditions.
picks.title: When Norfolk Flooded, ODU Coastal Defense Research Faced an Unexpected Real-World Test
